schema: Every numeric leaf has C/P and source_script. C=exact algebraic check, P=numerical evidence without interval certification.
model: Independent Penrose multigrid plus independent AB Euler-Bernoulli rigid-frame solver, r=.03, unit EA and edge, hydrostatic stress; axial-force geometric stiffness.
independence: Only and penrose/penrose_results.json were read from the Penrose solver. Its code was not read, imported or reused.

verdicts.representation: Confirmed for the differentiable linear response. Symmetry alone allows nondifferentiable degree-one b-driven fourfold terms.
verdicts.matched_pairs: Substantial a coupling and unresolved small b coefficient reproduced on three pairs with fresh phase averages.
verdicts.isotropic_penalty: Reproduced at fixed vertex count, area, tile composition and mean axial force; universal slope coefficient, exact asymptotic exponent and every phason direction are unproved.
verdicts.offset: Reported finite-offset penalty reproduced; strict finite-cell maximum over continuous offset is ruled out by identical-geometry plateaus.
verdicts.small_flips: Universal lowering is refuted by a mesh-checked raising flip, independently regenerated as another canonical approximant phase.
verdicts.long_disorder: Large pressure loss reproduced; run length does not certify equilibration and the observed range depends on sample/time.
verdicts.window_metric: Empirical correlations are reported for both the protocol-matched and expanded ensembles; they are not a universal monotonicity law.
